edits.before: Ryze is a weak, mana-starved level 1 with no dash and no escape until he has items, and you out-bully that. The instant you hit 2 with Q+E, look to E him into a wall for the stun and follow with a max-HP Q — his flat poke can't out-trade your tankiness and your Q ignores his shield's value. Dodge his telegraphed Q (the bouncing bolt) and don't walk into his E-marked minion, or his root chains off it.
edits.after: Ryze is a weak, mana-starved level 1 with no dash and no escape until he has items, and you out-bully that. The instant you hit 2 with Q+E, look to E him into a wall for the stun and follow with a max-HP Q — his flat poke can't out-trade your tankiness and your Q ignores his shield's value. Overload is a line bolt that stops on the first target, so stand behind minions, and never eat Spell Flux — Rune Prison only roots through it.

edits.after: Your R is a safety tool here, not burst — the tap-knockup shoves him clear of his own Realm Warp portal, or peels him off you when Rune Prison lands.
